takeaways: The 34.0-point margin was larger than either team's main lineup leak, so the matchup was decided more by raw scoring than one obvious swap.
The clearest unit edge was total WR output: Nacua-Cola by 62.7 points.
Against projection, Nacua-Cola finished +41.4 while Joe’s Cocksmithing Station finished +14.1.
The biggest started performance was Bijan Robinson for Joe’s Cocksmithing Station at 33.1 points.
